'''Hizuki Misono''' (Japanese: '''御園日月''' ''Misono Hizuki'') is an illustrator for the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. She is also a staff member of the [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series]] games and one of its [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness|animated specials]]. She is a staff member to other games, including [[Pokémon Colosseum]].
